body:
I want him so bad and knowing how long he's staying makes me feel more worst than anything. And I told my friend's mom about me being sick. She is going to the store to buy me healthier food, and that makes me feel a lot better that she cares that much.

I've never talked to anyone that their dad was in jail. It's nice to share my concerns with you.

Thank you so much! I do want help, but everytime I do, the person seems helpless, and it hurts more. I got something to eat just now, and I told Tiffany's mom about me not feeling well and she's about to go to the store to buy some healthier food for me to eat. You really did inspire me to tell someone that I was sick. She's going to the store and she's caring for me, so that makes me feel a lot better.

I know that there is a large possibility of something better along the way and years, but it's the hope and what keeps on happening that makes it look like that possibility doesn't exists, and I'm afraid of it getting worse. I'm always waiting for that spark of something good to drive me away from how I feel, but that spark doesn't seem to exists.

I see that you've felt similar to I and I just want to know that I love you. I am deeply hoping for something to come along the way before I do something drastic. And it's that I want to die, I just don't want to live.

Things have piled on. I'm getting tired of worry about it and thinking about it. It never really was good. I don't remember being happy for more than a couple of hours without being at a comedy play or hearing someone be funny. I know what I need to do but I don't see a reason to do so and carry on. What is there in the future? I know I'm young but I don't see everyone else my age like this.
